title: D4 agent output (d4-evidence-quoter)
description: Section 12/D4 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d4-evidence-quoter.md's worked output shape: {"link_type", "derivation_steps", "evidence": [{"for","passage_id","exact_line"}], "supports_answer", "missing", "note"}. Created as part of the D1-D4 runner-plugin build (2026-10), replacing the empty placeholder schema file. Cross-checks that need the per-item input context (exact_line found word-for-word in its passage via quote_verify.find; passage_id among the latest passages actually given; rule_used needs >=1 quote for:'rule', rules_chained needs >=2; states_answer needs empty derivation_steps; a statement question marked fully needs one quote per statement; the numerical derivation cross-check) live in scripts/checks/D4.py, same split as every other agent-output schema in this build (e.g. schemas/C1.json, schemas/B8.json).

derivation_steps.description: Short algebra/arithmetic/unit-conversion/logic steps only, in words or LaTeX. Must be empty when link_type is states_answer.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
